# The safety instructions

> [!CAUTION]
> Keep your hands away from the blade. The blade can cause an injury.

> [!CAUTION]
> Do not drop the unit. A fall can cause damage to the unit.

Make sure that the switch is off (the pump stops, the light of the panel
changes to red, the valve closes, and the pressure of the tank decreases to
zero before the next step starts).

Make sure that the switch is off (the light of the panel is red).
